title: The Ark Brought to Jerusalem

questions.question: From where did David and the people bring up the ark of God?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:2 (ESV): "...from Baale-judah to bring up from there the ark of God..."

questions.question: How was the ark transported initially?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:3 (ESV): "And they carried the ark of God on a new cart..."

questions.question: Who died when he touched the ark?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:7 (ESV): "...And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah, and God struck him down there..."

questions.question: Who despised David in her heart when she saw him dancing?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:16 (ESV): "...Michal the daughter of Saul... saw King David leaping and dancing... and she despised him in her heart."

questions.question: What happened to Michal because of her criticism?
options: She had no child to the day of her death
questions.correctAnswer: She had no child to the day of her death
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:23 (ESV): "And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death."

questions.question: Where did the ark stay for three months after Uzzah's death?
options: The house of Obed-edom the Gittite
questions.correctAnswer: The house of Obed-edom the Gittite
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:11 (ESV): "And the ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months..."

questions.question: What happened to Obed-edom while the ark was with him?
options: The Lord blessed him and all his household
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord blessed him and all his household
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:11 (ESV): "...and the LORD blessed Obed-edom and all his household."

questions.question: What did David wear when he danced before the Lord?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:14 (ESV): "And David was wearing a linen ephod."

questions.question: How many paces did they go before sacrificing an ox and a fattened animal?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:13 (ESV): "And when those who bore the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened animal."

questions.question: Michal accused David of uncovering himself before whom?
options: The eyes of his servants' female servants
questions.correctAnswer: The eyes of his servants' female servants
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:20 (ESV): "...uncovering himself today before the eyes of his servants' female servants..."

questions.question: What two men drove the new cart?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:3 (ESV): "...and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were driving the new cart."

questions.question: What was the place called where Uzzah died?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:8 (ESV): "And David was angry because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah. And that place is called Perez-uzzah..."

questions.question: What specific instruments were played during the first attempt to move the ark?
options: Lyres, harps, tambourines, castanets, and cymbals
questions.correctAnswer: Lyres, harps, tambourines, castanets, and cymbals
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:5 (ESV): "...with songs and lyres and harps and tambourines and castanets and cymbals."

questions.question: David gave every man and woman in Israel a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 6:19 (ESV): "...a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins to each..."

questions.question: Why did the oxen stumble?
options: (Not stated, but happened at the threshing floor of Nacon)
questions.correctAnswer: (Not stated, but happened at the threshing floor of Nacon)

key_verse_text: And David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD... I will make merry before the LORD.” (ESV)
